title: Why 1.1.1.1 refuses to forward EDNS subnet data

title: Hidden div that disabled Edge's video acceleration

title: Why Go built its own toolchain and stacks
why: Standard C ABIs lacked segmented stacks and precise stack maps, so Go needed its own toolchain for growable stacks and a precise GC.

title: Why generics are hard to add to Go

title: Solidity's surprising defaults and semantics
